messages:
Nora: FYI Devon resigned today, final day Fri 2026-05-02. They own a short migration and have client sandbox access. Need a low-risk offboard plan.
Devon: I'll finish migration prep and tag secrets. Can do a handoff Thu morning.
Maya-IT: Proposed timeline:
- 09:00 final day: set Slack to away
- 11:00: lock repo write + revoke deploy tokens
- 14:00: disable Okta & VPN
- 14:05: rotate vault secrets and service keys
- 14:30: remove from client sandboxes
Commands I'll run for audit:
```
oktactl deactivate-user --user devon
vault kv get secret/clients/acme/devon
vault delete secret/clients/acme/devon
aws iam remove-user-from-group --group-name Devs --user-name devon
```
Ravi: Security ask: snapshot active sessions and API keys before rotation. If there are personal SSH keys on bastion, rotate them. I'll run entitlement report after Maya finishes.
Harper: COBRA packet queued for 2026-05-03. Benefits end date 2026-05-16. Exit interview Mon 2026-05-04 11:00.
Nora: Offboard checklist created in Notion, link sent privately. Devon please upload handover docs to the drive folder.
Devon: Uploaded runbook and outstanding tickets: https://drive.redwood.com/handovers/devon-migration.pdf. Vault path noted.
IT-bot: Reminder: create JIRA OFFBOARD ticket and attach checklist https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OFFBOARD-2499
Maya-IT: Executed rotations on final day, posted logs to JIRA.
Ravi: Entitlement audit complete  no lingering Okta or AWS access; rotated bastion keys.
Harper: Final paycheck processes 2026-05-06; PTO payout included. COBRA notice sent.
Nora: Laptop received and courier closed. OFFBOARD-2499 moved to Done. Thanks everyone.
